headline: Brazil Stocks Fall 1.4% Ahead of Copom Rate Decision
summary: Brazil stocks fell 1.4% to a six-month low and the real weakened ahead of the Copom Selic interest rate decision.
why: Central bank interest rate decisions are primary drivers of domestic equity valuations, currency exchange rates, and fixed-income yields in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Brazilian Real
impacts.why: Uncertainty ahead of the Copom interest rate decision pressured the currency and stocks.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Investor caution ahead of the central bank rate decision led to equity outflows and currency depreciation.
